problem: A crash between Signoff payload creation and signature publication permanently blocked finalize retry; a completed exact Signoff also could not be idempotently recovered.
cause: Finalize treated any existing payload or signature as an undifferentiated immutable collision instead of distinguishing half-orphan from a valid complete pair.
rule: Under Registry and roster locks, quarantine XOR signoff artifacts atomically; recover a complete pair only after role-key signature, exact schema, timestamp, and all immutable bindings validate; otherwise fail closed without overwriting evidence.
applies_to: Crash-safe signed artifact publication and idempotent audit finalization
